value.rationale: Full infinite-refinement BV gain is the natural sharp stability invariant for a classical interpolatory, cubic-reproducing subdivision scheme that rings near step data. Its value is not the easily calculated one-step gain (1.25) or two-step gain (1.28125); the result supplies an attainable sharp norm, convergent analytic bounds across a natural tension range and a genuinely certified sub-micro-unit numerical enclosure at the standard cubic tension. This is a motivated exact invariant of a standard approximation object, not a chosen arbitrary finite slice.
